data.content_ref: inline:The mechanism explicitly lays out a sandboxed Python simulation in four concrete steps — enumerate optimal 12-input networks up to reflection symmetry, search extension comparator sets of sizes 1-7 on channel 12, verify each candidate via the 0-1 principle over all 8192 binary vectors, and report the minimum extension size — yet simulation_refs is empty. The problem standard states that 'a simulation described in prose with an empty simulation_refs channel is an unverified claim and will be criticized as such.' The central claim ('every symmetry-reduced optimal 12-input network requires more than 5 additional comparators') is precisely the unverified output of this described-but-unfiled simulation; it is presented as established fact ('cannot yield...because every...requires more than 5') when it is actually an untested hypothesis.
